---
title: "Red Lentil Soup"
description: Cheap, freezes well, and better on the second day.
categories: [lunch, dinner, vegan, batch-cook, one-pot]
time: 40 min
servings: 4
---

## Ingredients

- 2 tbsp olive oil
- 1 onion, diced
- 2 carrots, diced
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tbsp tomato paste
- 2 tsp ground cumin
- 1 tsp ground coriander
- 250 g red lentils, rinsed
- 1.2 l vegetable stock
- 1 lemon
- Salt
- Black pepper

## Method

1. Soften the onion and carrot in the oil over medium heat for 10 minutes, with a good pinch of salt.
2. Add the garlic, tomato paste, cumin and coriander. Cook for 2 minutes, stirring, until the paste darkens.
3. Stir in the lentils and stock. Bring to a boil, then simmer partly covered for 25 minutes, until the lentils have collapsed.
4. Blend smooth, or leave it rough if you prefer. Loosen with water if it is thicker than you want.
5. Season, then add lemon juice a squeeze at a time until it tastes bright rather than flat. This step is the whole recipe.

Freezes for three months. Freeze it before the lemon goes in and add that fresh on reheating.
